_README: Structured onboarding. Maps answers deterministically onto (a) a values profile and (b) pattern tags. No inference beyond the explicit scoring weights below. Edit questions/options freely; keep option ids stable if you have existing users.

intro.title: Let's get oriented
intro.body: A few honest questions. There are no right answers, and nothing here is a diagnosis — it just helps Compass point you at what matters to you. Your answers stay on this device.

patternTags.label: Avoidance
patternTags.description: Putting off what matters when it feels uncomfortable.

patternTags.label: People-pleasing
patternTags.description: Prioritising others' approval over your own needs.

questions.prompt: When you're at your best, what are you usually moving toward?

options.label: Learning and getting better at something
Being close to people I care about
Doing things my own way, on my own terms
Feeling stable and safe
Making a difference to something bigger than me
Feeling healthy and energised

questions.prompt: Think of something you keep meaning to do but haven't. What's most true about the gap?

options.label: It feels uncomfortable, so I keep finding other things to do
I can't start until I know I'll do it well
I'm too busy with things I said yes to for other people
I keep turning it over in my head instead of acting

questions.prompt: After you make a mistake, the loudest voice in your head usually…

options.label: Tears into me — I should've known better
Replays it on a loop for hours or days
Wants to avoid the thing that caused it
Notes it and moves on fairly quickly

questions.prompt: When someone asks for your time and you don't have it, you…

options.label: Usually say yes anyway and figure it out later
Say no but feel guilty about it
Say no fairly cleanly

questions.prompt: If one area got noticeably better over the next month, which would you pick?

options.label: Career / direction
Energy / burnout
Relationships
Habits / follow-through
